findings.title: An Arabic hint on the wrong side of the field
findings.message: The placeholder "اكتب رسالتك..." is Arabic in a left-to-right field.
findings.fix: Keep dir="ltr" for what people type, and right-align the Arabic hint with input:placeholder-shown { direction: rtl } or ::placeholder { text-align: right }.
findings.snippet: <input type="text" class="message-input" id="messageInput" placeholder="اكتب رسالتك..." dir="auto">

findings.title: Punctuation at the wrong end
findings.message: "فهمت. سأ reported these to the technical…" runs right to left, so its last mark moves to the start.
findings.fix: Give the block the direction of its own text, with dir="ltr", dir="rtl" or dir="auto".
findings.snippet: فهمت. سأ reported these to the technical team. Please wait.

findings.title: Two digit systems on one screen
findings.message: "TX-48213" uses a different digit system from the rest of the screen.
findings.fix: Pick one digit system for the product and format every number with it.

findings.title: Arabic lines set too tight
findings.message: Line height is 1.40 on "شكراً. هل جربت تشغيل المودم مرة أخرى؟".
findings.fix: Give Arabic body text a line height of about 1.6 to 1.8, for example :lang(ar) { line-height: 1.7 }.

findings.title: Position, float or border that does not mirror
findings.message: border-bottom-right-radius: 4px stays on the same side in Arabic.
findings.fix: Use inset-inline-start, float: inline-start, border-inline-start and border-start-start-radius.
